thread:
megan: Heads-up 1: need a clean copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing trio + a short launch post and webinar promo by 5pm PT. Who can help finalize?

dave: I can knock out the mode toggles and benchmark strip. Want a single hero line or separate heroes per mode?
sara: Single hero with concise subtext feels cleaner. Then mode-specific toggles with quick benefits.
leo: Draft hero: 'Ship LLM features with predictable latency and reliable unit economics.' Subline: 'One API for Hosted, Dedicated, and Private inference.' Thoughts?
megan: Nice. Change "unit economics" to "predictable unit economics"?
leo: Yep: '...and predictable unit economics.'
ria: Toggle copy suggestions: Hosted -> 'Hosted API  Fast to start, usage-based pricing, free credits'; Dedicated -> 'Dedicated  reserved GPU capacity, SLA-backed throughput'; Private -> 'Private  VPC, HSM/KMS, on-prem bundles & audit logs.' Keep them snappy.
ashley: For the launch post lead: short narrative + benchmark highlights + webinar CTA. Lead suggestion: 'Today we launch a unified inference platform that makes LLMs practical at production scale  whether you want the simplicity of a hosted API, the predictability of reserved capacity, or the controls of a private deployment.'
dave: Benchmarks: let's call out p50 latency and k tokens/sec for two model families. Example ribbon: 'Benchmarks (median p50): Llama-2 variants: 45ms p50; Mistral-like: 38ms p50 on our Dedicated profile' with link to perf page. Avoid absolute claims about competitors.
sara: Webinar blurb for signups: 'Deep dive + live demo: How we cut per-token costs using batching, prefix KV caching, and smart routing. Engineers welcome.' Button: 'Reserve your spot' and secondary CTA: 'View benchmarks'.
megan: Good. For inbound routing: if someone signs up for the webinar tag event=webinar_signup -> marketing:webinar; demo_request -> sales:demo. Include property chosen_mode = hosted/dedicated/private if provided. Route rules in playbook.
ria: I'll add short YAML snippet for the docs team: 
```yaml
routing:
  - event: webinar_signup
    tag: marketing:webinar
    dest: inbox:marketing-growth
  - event: demo_request
    tag: sales:demo
    dest: queue:ae
    props: [chosen_mode]
```
ashley: Also recommend a brief FAQ line under Private: 'Security & compliance: VPC peering, dedicated HSM/KMS integration, audit logging, SOC2-ready configs.'
dave: Can we squeeze a three-bullet 'Why choose each mode' under toggles? Quick bullets per mode.
leo: Draft bullets: Hosted: 'Fast onboarding, free credits, pay-as-you-go.' Dedicated: 'Predictable throughput, reserved GPU pools, SLA.' Private: 'Network isolation, enterprise key mgmt, on-prem support.'
sara: Social post short copy: 'Launch: predictable LLM inference across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Join our launch webinar to see benchmarks and a live demo. Reserve your spot.'
megan: Prefer 'predictable unit economics' in social line. Also add hashtag #LLMInfra
marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow up in 24h to lock final hero for A/B test.
megan: I'll assemble final assets and post for review at 3pm. Drop any edits before 2:30pm here. :thumbsup:
